name: fld_isSquare_neg_three_zmod_iff
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 3 < p) : IsSquare (-3 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 3 = 1
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 3 < p), IsSquare (-3 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 3 = 1
informal: -3 is a quadratic residue mod a prime p > 3 iff p ≡ 1 (mod 3) — either via legendreSym multiplicativity, (-1/p) and quadratic reciprocity for 3, or directly: -3 = (2ω+1)^2 where ω is a primitive cube root of unity, which exists in F_p iff 3 | p-1.
